People: Jean Lévesque Burigny (author, Wikidata Q3173209), died 1785. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Burigny, M. de (Jean Lévesque), 1692-1785") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The life of the truly eminent and learned Hugo Grotius. ... together with a critical account of his works. Written originally in French. By M. de Burigny.  1754, 1754, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bim_eighteenth-century_the-life-of-the-truly-em_burigny-m-de-jean-lv_1754. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 89%, 85%, 54% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Jean Lévesque Burigny, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
